To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
AI is a tool that is designed to be used by humans to achieve a specific goal.

(i) the relationship between humans, and the AI they create, will be a complex, multidimensional, and dynamic one, (ii) trust will be the most important element of that relationship, and (iii) the social integration of AI will be a continuous process of negotiation between the two entities, and the outcome will be a dynamic equilibrium of the human and the machine.

(1) The human AI relationship is an emerging field of research that has not received the attention that it deserves; (2) The social integration of AI in human society is not possible without a relationship; (3) The relationship will be influenced by the nature of the human and the nature of the machine and the nature of their interaction; (4) The nature of the relationship will be influenced, in part, by the nature of trust between the human and the machine;
In summary, our research is concerned with
the nature of trust, and the role that humans play in the human AI relationship.
how humans and AI will coexist, and how they will interact in the future, and the role trust will play in this relationship.
the nature of the human AI relationship, the nature of the trust in that relationship, the role of trust, and how the human AI relationship can be designed for a trustworthy social integration.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
AI will not be a replacement for humans, rather a complement, and that the relationship will be a partnership.
the human AI relationship is a symbiotic one, and that the human AI interface is the most crucial element in the human AI relationship, which will be the subject of further research.
AI will not be able to replace humans in the human society, but it will complement humans in their social activities and will become a part of human society.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the social integration of AI will be a human centred process.
the social integration of AI is not only about how to trust an AI but also how to trust humans to be able to trust the AI.
, for the foreseeable future, humans and machines would be working in partnership in the human social system, and the human AI relationship is a social construct that is based on trust.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the relationship between humans in society and AI is a complex and dynamic process that will be influenced by a number of factors, some of which are still not fully understood.
the human AI relationship is a two way street. It is not a one-way street, in which AI would be a mere tool for the humans.
AI should be seen as an enabler for the human society to achieve a higher level of social integration, and that the social integration of AI is a process, not an end in itself.
